marimo.label: Marimo notebooks
marimo.description: Run Python in a live marimo notebook kernel with the marimo-pair skill to inspect notebook variables, dataframes, cells, and outputs. Useful when the task involves a marimo notebook or data loaded in a running notebook session. Code runs in the kernel, so it could change notebook state.
